ABOUT INVENTIFF 
 Inventiff is a software development and digital product agency based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We work as a full-service tech partner for companies of different sizes and industries, helping them turn ideas into scalable digital products, from custom software, web platforms and mobile apps to APIs, integrations and cloud infrastructure. Our team covers the full delivery cycle, from discovery and design to development, testing and ongoing support. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a Golang Developer to build fast, reliable backend services for our clients' products. You will design and develop APIs and distributed systems, work on performance-sensitive components, and collaborate closely with frontend, QA and DevOps colleagues to take features from design to production. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Design, develop and maintain backend services and microservices in Go 
 Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs 
 Write efficient, concurrent code using goroutines, channels and Go best practices 
 Work with relational and NoSQL databases and optimize data access 
 Integrate with third-party services, message queues and internal systems 
 Write clean, tested and well-documented code, and take part in code reviews 
 Monitor, troubleshoot and improve the performance and reliability of services in production 
 Contribute to architecture discussions and continuous improvement of our practices 
 MUST HAVE 
 3+ years of professional backend development experience, with at least 2 years of hands-on Go 
 Solid understanding of Go concurrency (goroutines, channels, context) and the standard library 
 Experience building RESTful APIs; experience with gRPC / Protocol Buffers is a plus 
 Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and SQL 
 Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems fundamentals 
 Experience with testing in Go (unit and integration tests) 
 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines and Docker 
 Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams 
 Good communication skills and English at B2 level or higher 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience with messaging systems such as Kafka, NATS or RabbitMQ 
 Experience with NoSQL / caching solutions (Redis, MongoDB) 
 Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) 
 Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) 
 Experience with performance profiling and optimization (pprof) 
 Knowledge of another backend language (Java, Python, Node.js or Rust) 
 Awareness of secure coding practices 
 ﻿ 
 WHAT WE OFFER 
 Fully remote work 
 Long-term collaboration on a variety of client projects and industries 
 A small, senior-minded team where your input shapes technical decisions 
 Direct communication with clients and stakeholders, no unnecessary layers 
 Room to learn and work with modern tools, including AI-assisted development
